facts.fact: 1941年8月5日博物馆通知Léon画被抢（"J'ai l'honneur"开头）；8月10日Léon打字抗议信给Jaujard，列家族捐赠（Villa Kérylos、Manet的The Fifer、Musée Camondo）；"写抗议信而不逃、 filing appeals 而不躲"是"小而致命的决定"。
facts.anchor: Every group that was ever marked, ever herded by military forces or men in masks into lines or trucks or trains or camps, believed the same story: not here, not us, not by our glorious state.

facts.fact: Léon请求"归还姿态"：一幅家庭肖像"在家庭中的位置有特殊意义，完全独立于其艺术或市场价值"；Carcopino（Vichy教育部长）8月27日把请求转给Vallat。
facts.anchor: After all that, Léon asked for a “gesture of restitution.” The return of Irène’s portrait.

facts.fact: Xavier Vallat（犹太事务总署署长，49岁，木腿、独眼）：犹太人是"不可同化的外国人"、想"在国家内建立超级国家"；1918年犹太医生救了他的命；Debré评他"既无心也无脑"。
facts.anchor: The Jew is not only an unassimilable foreigner, whose implantation tends to form a state within the state

facts.fact: Guy de Rothschild解释为何不逃："荣誉和尊严受伤，不接受被当作贱民"；Irène和Béatrice留下，认为"真正的风险在于试图逃跑"；Suzanne扮女仆骗过盖世太保后逃出。
facts.anchor: Why didn’t I decide to leave the country at once? In fact, this was practically impossible. Wounded in my honor, my dignity, I did not accept this role of a pariah.

facts.fact: André Tulard建立四色"fichier des juifs"（名字/地址/职业/国籍）：Seine省85,664条法国犹太人+64,070条外国犹太人；纳粹印象深刻，成为其他占领国标准；用于围捕。
facts.anchor: The color-coded French fichier so impressed the Nazis that it became the standard in other occupied nations.

facts.fact: Vallat在Carcopino转来的请求边缘只写了一个字："Non"；"那不仅是对一幅画的判决，而是消失的官僚速记"；整个家族对国家的忠诚史被缩减为一个拒绝。
facts.anchor: That was the verdict on more than a painting. It was bureaucratic shorthand for disappearance.
